SELECT count(*)::int
FROM "Posts" AS p
INNER JOIN "Categories" AS c ON p."CategoryId" = c."Id"
WHERE p."IsActive" AND p."IsPublished" AND p."PublishDate" <= @utcNow AND c."IsActive"

SELECT p."Id", p."Title", p."Slug", p."Summary", p."ThumbnailUrl", c."Name", p."PublishDate", p."ViewCount"
FROM "Posts" AS p
INNER JOIN "Categories" AS c ON p."CategoryId" = c."Id"
WHERE p."IsActive" AND p."IsPublished" AND p."PublishDate" <= @utcNow AND c."IsActive"
ORDER BY p."PublishDate" DESC, p."Id"
LIMIT @p2 OFFSET @p

SELECT p."Id", p."CategoryId", p."Content", p."CreatedDate", p."EditVersion", p."Excerpt", p."IsActive", p."IsPublished", p."PublishDate", p."Slug", p."Summary", p."ThumbnailUrl", p."Title", p."UpdatedDate", p."ViewCount", c."Id", c."CreatedDate", c."EditVersion", c."IsActive", c."Name", c."Slug"
FROM "Posts" AS p
INNER JOIN "Categories" AS c ON p."CategoryId" = c."Id"
WHERE p."IsActive" AND p."IsPublished" AND p."PublishDate" <= @utcNow AND c."IsActive" AND p."Slug" = @slug
LIMIT 1

SELECT count(*)::int
FROM "Posts" AS p
INNER JOIN "Categories" AS c ON p."CategoryId" = c."Id"
WHERE p."IsActive" AND p."IsPublished" AND p."PublishDate" <= @utcNow AND c."IsActive" AND (p."Title" ILIKE @pattern ESCAPE '\' OR p."Content" ILIKE @pattern ESCAPE '\')

Plans.Filter: ("IsActive" AND "IsPublished" AND ("PublishDate" <= '2026-10-04 03:00:00+03'::timestamp with time zone) AND (("Title" ~~* '%needle%'::text) OR ("Content" ~~* '%needle%'::text)))

FROM "Posts" AS p
INNER JOIN "Categories" AS c ON p."CategoryId" = c."Id"
WHERE p."IsActive" AND p."IsPublished" AND p."PublishDate" <= @utcNow AND c."IsActive" AND (p."Title" ILIKE @pattern ESCAPE '\' OR p."Content" ILIKE @pattern ESCAPE '\')

SELECT p0."Id", p0."Title", p0."Slug", p0."CategoryId", c."Name", p0."IsActive", c."IsActive", p0."IsPublished", p0."PublishDate", p0."CreatedDate", p0."ViewCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p."Id", p."CategoryId", p."CreatedDate", p."IsActive", p."IsPublished", p."PublishDate", p."Slug", p."Title", p."ViewCount"
    FROM "Posts" AS p
    ORDER BY p."CreatedDate" DESC, p."Id"
    LIMIT @p1 OFFSET @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN "Categories" AS c ON p0."CategoryId" = c."Id"
ORDER BY p0."CreatedDate" DESC, p0."Id"

SELECT p."Id", p."CategoryId", p."Content", p."CreatedDate", p."EditVersion", p."Excerpt", p."IsActive", p."IsPublished", p."PublishDate", p."Slug", p."Summary", p."ThumbnailUrl", p."Title", p."UpdatedDate", p."ViewCount", c."Id", c."CreatedDate", c."EditVersion", c."IsActive", c."Name", c."Slug"
FROM "Posts" AS p
INNER JOIN "Categories" AS c ON p."CategoryId" = c."Id"
WHERE p."IsActive" AND p."IsPublished" AND p."PublishDate" <= @utcNow AND c."IsActive" AND p."CategoryId" = @categoryId AND p."Id" <> @currentPostId
ORDER BY p."PublishDate" DESC, p."Id"
LIMIT @p
